high_level_description: This image captures a scene at what appears to be a Formula One pit lane or garage area. The setting is modern and industrial, with a large building featuring multiple garage doors and glass railings on the upper level. The building has a sleek, contemporary design with a mix of metallic and glass elements. In the foreground, there is a Formula One race car prominently displayed. The car is predominantly red with various sponsor logos, including "Shell," "HP," "Kia," "Pirelli," and "AWS." The car also features the Ferrari logo, indicating it is part of the Ferrari team.
